caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional statue of a man standing on a simple black rectangular base. The man is dressed in a tan hat, a green long-sleeve shirt, a red vest, a red neckerchief, light brown and yellow striped pants, and black-and-white shoes. His right arm is bent and extended forward with a closed hand, while his left hand rests on his hip. His head is turned to his left and his facial features are detailed, with a wide mouth and visible teeth. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color. The composition centers the statue, showing it in profile view, and the artist's signature is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Hitching Post
